name: generate_sfx
description: Generate a sound effect from a text description via ElevenLabs. Generation step — produces a file on disk; composition happens at render time.

output.description: Path to the generated sound effect (plus duration metadata when --json)

params.name: out
params.description: Output audio file path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: duration
params.description: Length in seconds (0.5-30). Omit to let ElevenLabs choose.

params.name: model
params.description: Override the connector's default model (default: eleven_text_to_sound_v2)
